question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"affects."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The verb **"affects"** means to have an influence on or cause a change in something. (किसी वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति के व्‍यवहार को प्रभावित करना; असर डालना) • **Example**: *Her personal problems seem to be **affecting**__ her work.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it fits the context of the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 1. • **Correct passage**: Seasonal winds are a natural phenomenon that__** affects**__ weather patterns across the globe...............​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (calculates)** means to determine mathematically. (गणना करना, हिसाब लगाना, परिकलन करना) • **Option 3 (collides)** means to crash into or come into conflict with something. (गतिमान वस्‍तुओं का टकराना; टकराव होना) • **Option 4 (exaggerates) **means to overstate or magnify something beyond its actual size or importance. ((किसी बात को) बढ़ा-चढ़ा कर कहना) 48:Tdc8, The correct answer is **"vary."**
